facts.en: Completed a diploma in Creative Project Administration at Fictional Institute D089 in 2022.
facts.zh: 2022 年在虚构院校 D089 完成创意项目行政专科学历。

facts.en: Worked as a studio project assistant at Fictional Design Cooperative D089 from 2023-01 to 2026-08.
facts.zh: 2023-01 至 2026-08 在虚构设计合作社 D089 担任工作室项目助理。

facts.en: Maintained briefing folders, revision logs and review invitations for small visual-design assignments.
facts.zh: 为小型视觉设计任务维护简报文件夹、修订记录及审查邀请。

facts.en: Checked client-supplied dimensions and copy against the approved brief before routing inconsistencies to designers.
facts.zh: 根据获批简报检查客户提供的尺寸及文案，再将不一致处转交设计师。

facts.en: Coordinated review records for a team submission to Fictional Community Design Showcase S089 in 2025-05.
facts.zh: 在 2025-05 为团队提交至虚构社区设计展示 S089 的作品协调审查记录。

facts.en: The submission was displayed in the general participation area; no shortlist, judging score or prize is recorded.
facts.zh: 该作品在一般参与区域展示；未记录入围名单、评审分数或奖项。

facts.en: Designers created the displayed visuals; the candidate assembled required files and checked submission metadata.
facts.zh: 设计师创作展示视觉作品；候选人整理所需文件并检查提交元数据。

facts.en: With the project lead, checked 65 deliverable filenames during a 2025-09 client handover.
facts.zh: 在 2025-09 客户交接期间，与项目负责人合作检查 65 个交付文件名。

facts.en: The team corrected 9 mismatched revision suffixes among those 65 files before handover; no client revenue effect was measured.
facts.zh: 团队在交接前修正该批 65 个文件中的 9 个修订后缀不匹配；未测量客户收入影响。

facts.en: Prepared a 2026-01 file-naming guide adopted by the project lead.
facts.zh: 2026-01 准备文件命名指南，由项目负责人采纳。

facts.en: Drafted a new studio portfolio layout in 2026-06; it was a proposal and was not published.
facts.zh: 2026-06 起草工作室作品集新布局；仅为提案，未发布。

facts.en: At the 2025-10 peak, tracked 7 client review folders; the normal 2026-08 assignment was 3.
facts.zh: 在 2025-10 高峰期跟踪 7 个客户审查文件夹；2026-08 常规分工为 3 个。

facts.en: Completed a 2024-04 typography exercise course using fictional poster briefs; it was not paid client design work.
facts.zh: 2024-04 使用虚构海报简报完成字体排印练习课程；并非有偿客户设计工作。

facts.en: Volunteered for Fictional Makers Display V089 on Saturdays from 2024-07 to 2024-11 while employed, labeling exhibition stands.
facts.zh: 2024-07 至 2024-11 任职期间，星期六在虚构创客展示 V089 志愿标记展台。

facts.en: Made a personal collage series of imaginary storefronts in 2021, outside the studio role.
facts.zh: 2021 年在工作室岗位之外制作个人虚构店面拼贴系列。

facts.en: Keeps a hobby notebook of paper-folding mechanisms.
facts.zh: 保留记录纸折结构的爱好笔记。

facts.en: A portfolio caption calls the showcase entry award-winning, but the retained evidence is only a participation acknowledgment.
facts.zh: 作品集图注称展示参赛作品获奖，但留存证据仅为参与确认。

facts.en: Recorded client feedback without accepting scope changes or approving design fees.
facts.zh: 记录客户反馈，不接受范围变更或批准设计费用。

facts.en: Separated approved finals from working drafts and maintained an archive index for internal retrieval.
facts.zh: 将获批最终版与工作草稿分开，并维护内部调阅档案索引。
